primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{rule}': 'rule set defining contest structure', 'P_{dispute}': 'probability of contested outcome'}

primitives.name: Gentlemanly Competition Duality
primitives.verbatim_quote: Face it like a man, and say with your whole heart that you are on the side of the men who want no chance of retreat or escape, only a fair contest and certain victory or defeat at the end of it.
primitives.assumptions: Competitive integrity requires zero escape probability and full commitment to outcome.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_{defeat} < 0.9, moral commitment to competition fails.

layer2.mapping: GSI probabilistic duality between moral commitment and outcome certainty maps to GSE binary state evolution.
layer2.telemetry: Moral alignment score vs. outcome consistency index.
